"""Optimize both original schedules and compare the observed and classical plans."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import cast

import torch

import flagquantum as fq
from flagquantum.algorithms import CobylaOptimizer

from . import problem, quantum

SHOTS = 2048


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Evaluation:
    parameters: tuple[float, ...]
    quantile_cost: float


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Result:
    problem: problem.Problem
    quantile: float
    trace: tuple[Evaluation, ...]
    parameters: tuple[float, ...]
    counts: tuple[tuple[int, int], ...]
    selected: int
    selected_cost: float
    selected_matrix: tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...]
    selected_valid: bool
    classical_cost: int
    classical_matrix: tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...]
    stopped: bool
    converged: bool


class _ObjectiveBudgetError(Exception):
    """Stop before the source's explicit evaluation budget is exceeded."""


def distribution(
    problem_: problem.Problem, parameters: tuple[float, ...]
) -> torch.Tensor:
    native = quantum.build(problem_, parameters)
    state = cast(torch.Tensor, fq.run(native).statevector()).reshape(-1)
    return state.abs().square()


def lower_quantile(
    problem_: problem.Problem, draws: torch.Tensor, quantile: float
) -> float:
    costs = problem.costs(problem_, draws).sort().values
    mass = quantile * draws.numel()
    full = int(mass)
    partial = mass - full
    total = costs[:full].sum()
    if partial:
        total += partial * costs[full]
    return float(total / mass)


def logical(words: torch.Tensor, width: int) -> torch.Tensor:
    out = torch.zeros_like(words)
    for bit in range(width):
        out |= ((words >> bit) & 1) << (width - 1 - bit)
    return out


def optimize(large: bool) -> Result:
    model = problem.create(large)
    max_queries = 1 if large else 20
    quantile = 0.6 if large else 0.3
    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(10)
    trace: list[Evaluation] = []

    def draw(parameters: tuple[float, ...]) -> torch.Tensor:
        physical = torch.multinomial(
            distribution(model, parameters),
            SHOTS,
            replacement=True,
            generator=generator,
        )
        return logical(physical, model.width)

    def evaluate(params: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        if len(trace) >= max_queries:
            raise _ObjectiveBudgetError()
        parameters = tuple(float(v) for v in params)
        value = lower_quantile(model, draw(parameters), quantile)
        trace.append(Evaluation(parameters, value))
        return torch.tensor(value, dtype=torch.float64)

    stopped = converged = False
    try:
        optimized = CobylaOptimizer(maxiter=100, rhobeg=1, rhoend=1e-8).minimize(
            evaluate,
            torch.tensor(quantum.initial_parameters(model), dtype=torch.float64),
        )
        converged = optimized.converged
    except _ObjectiveBudgetError:
        stopped = True
    parameters = min(trace, key=lambda row: row.quantile_cost).parameters
    words, counts = torch.unique(draw(parameters), return_counts=True)
    values = problem.costs(model, words)
    indices = sorted(
        range(words.numel()), key=lambda i: (float(values[i]), int(words[i]))
    )
    observations = tuple((int(words[i]), int(counts[i])) for i in indices)
    selected = observations[0][0]
    matrix = problem.decode(model, selected)
    classical_cost, classical_matrix = problem.classical(model)
    return Result(
        model,
        quantile,
        tuple(trace),
        parameters,
        observations,
        selected,
        problem.original_cost(model, selected),
        matrix,
        problem.valid(model, matrix),
        classical_cost,
        classical_matrix,
        stopped,
        converged,
    )

"""Show each original task graph, all measured costs, and actual schedules."""

from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from .workflow import Result

LABELS = (
    "small-input",
    "small-trace",
    "small-costs",
    "small-quantum",
    "small-classical",
    "large-input",
    "large-costs",
    "large-quantum",
    "large-classical",
)


def plan(
    result: Result, matrix: tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...] | None, title: str, path: Path
) -> None:
    model = result.problem
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(10, 7.5), layout="constrained")
    times = tuple(range(len(model.capacity)))
    used = (
        tuple(
            sum(a * b for a, b in zip(row, model.workload, strict=True))
            for row in matrix
        )
        if matrix is not None
        else (0,) * len(times)
    )
    axes[0, 0].bar(
        times, model.capacity, label="Available", color="tab:green", alpha=0.55
    )
    if matrix is not None:
        axes[0, 0].bar(times, used, width=0.45, label="Used", color="tab:red")
    axes[0, 0].set(
        title="Capacity", xlabel="Timeslot", ylabel="Resources", xticks=times
    )
    axes[0, 0].legend()
    axes[0, 1].bar(range(model.tasks), model.workload)
    axes[0, 1].set(
        title="Task workloads",
        xlabel="Task",
        ylabel="Resources",
        xticks=range(model.tasks),
    )
    positions = {}
    for task in range(model.tasks):
        assigned = [i for i, row in enumerate(matrix or ()) if row[task]]
        positions[task] = (
            float(assigned[0]) if assigned else float(task),
            float(task % 3),
        )
    for first, second in model.edges:
        axes[1, 0].annotate(
            "",
            positions[second],
            positions[first],
            arrowprops={
                "arrowstyle": "->",
                "color": "0.4",
                "shrinkA": 12,
                "shrinkB": 12,
            },
        )
    for task, (x, y) in positions.items():
        axes[1, 0].scatter(
            x, y, s=320, color="lightgreen", edgecolors="black", zorder=3
        )
        axes[1, 0].text(x, y, str(task), ha="center", va="center", zorder=4)
    axes[1, 0].set(
        title="Original task dependencies", xlabel="Assigned slot / source order"
    )
    axes[1, 0].margins(0.3)
    if matrix is not None:
        axes[1, 1].imshow(matrix, aspect="auto", vmin=0, vmax=1, cmap="OrRd")
        axes[1, 1].set(
            title="Actual task assignments",
            xlabel="Task",
            ylabel="Timeslot",
            xticks=range(model.tasks),
            yticks=times,
        )
    else:
        axes[1, 1].axis("off")
    fig.suptitle(title)
    fig.savefig(path, dpi=140)
    plt.close(fig)


def save(results: tuple[Result, Result], directory: Path) -> None:
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for result in results:
        name = result.problem.name
        plan(
            result,
            None,
            f"{name.title()} original scheduling instance",
            directory / f"{name}-input.png",
        )
        plan(
            result,
            result.selected_matrix,
            f"{name.title()} lowest-cost observed schedule • feasible={result.selected_valid}",
            directory / f"{name}-quantum.png",
        )
        plan(
            result,
            result.classical_matrix,
            f"{name.title()} independent classical schedule • finish={result.classical_cost}",
            directory / f"{name}-classical.png",
        )
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.5, 4.6), layout="constrained")
        # Plot every actually sampled cost with its observed multiplicity.
        from .problem import original_cost

        costs = [original_cost(result.problem, word) for word, _ in result.counts]
        weights = [count for _, count in result.counts]
        ax.hist(costs, bins=30, weights=weights)
        ax.set(
            title=f"{name.title()} observed cost distribution",
            xlabel="Original penalized cost",
            ylabel="Actual shots",
        )
        fig.savefig(directory / f"{name}-costs.png", dpi=140)
        plt.close(fig)
        if name == "small":
            fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.5, 4.6), layout="constrained")
            ax.plot(
                range(1, len(result.trace) + 1),
                [row.quantile_cost for row in result.trace],
            )
            ax.set(
                title="Small-instance sampled lower-tail objective",
                xlabel="Actual objective query",
                ylabel="CVaR cost (alpha = 0.3)",
            )
            fig.savefig(directory / "small-trace.png", dpi=140)
            plt.close(fig)

# Preserve the official entry. Retain only its last successful fq.run result;
# this is an observed execution, not a claim about the best optimizer candidate.
import runpy
import flagquantum as fq

_original_run = fq.run
_last_result = None

def _record_run(*args, **kwargs):
    global _last_result
    result = _original_run(*args, **kwargs)
    _last_result = result
    return result

fq.run = _record_run
try:
    runpy.run_module('examples.synthesis.applications.logistics.task_scheduling_problem.overview.main', run_name="__main__")
finally:
    fq.run = _original_run

    fq.save("last-observed-run.fqx", _last_result.plan, result=_last_result)
